description: A utility library of functions built specific for Net3000.ca applications.
releaseNotes: 10.0.64: Add user.created, user.saved and user.deleted security events and staff viewer options (#6299, #5659). Admin account-scoped profile create/save and soft-delete record metadata-only events after successful persistence, with resolved actor and opaque login ids. Same-value profile saves still emit user.saved (forced writes); refused/failed operations and ignored/already-deleted ids emit nothing. No schema change; invitation/revocation and password/2FA telemetry remain separate. 10.0.63: Re-apply the #6133 numeric-header allowlist and the #6196 tenant-token header precedence, with numeric account ids still working (#6312). 10.0.62 reverted both after refusing a numeric `account` header took every id-only client website offline below its home page. A numeric header now selects the tenant on every endpoint again, as in 10.0.55, but it is evaluated AFTER the explicit query and header tokens, so #6196 still holds: a real accountToken/token wins and an unresolvable token header still refuses rather than falling back. The allowlist and TryGetAllowedAccountHeader are unchanged and still report which headers they cover; a header honoured outside the allowlist is logged with outcome AccountIdQueryPolicy.LegacyHeaderOutcome ("legacy-compat") under net3000.common.AccountIdSelector, so the remaining id-only callers are countable. Remove this compatibility branch only once every client website sends a public account GUID token. 10.0.61: Add team.membership_added and team.membership_removed security events and staff viewer options (#6278, #5659). Admin user-team assignment records actual committed grant deltas with resolved actor, stored grant account and opaque login/team/grant ids. Client anchors use their actual account, not a null user home or submitted account. Empty/replayed/refused/failed operations emit no grant-change event. Existing assignment/authorization behavior and schema are unchanged. 10.0.60: Add team.permissions_saved security events and staff viewer option (#6258, #5659). Admin permission saves snapshot added/modified/deleted rows for the validated team and tenant before persistence, then record bounded row counts after success. Empty/refused/failed operations do not claim writes. Permission/menu rules and forced same-value writes are unchanged; the event describes saved writes rather than permission-value deltas. No new schema. 10.0.59: Add team.created, team.updated and team.deleted security event codes and staff viewer options (#6237, #5659). Admin team CRUD records metadata-only events after successful persistence; unchanged teams and refused/failed operations do not claim changes. Deletion targets come from owned committed rows rather than submitted ids. No new schema or authorization behavior; permission/membership and other takeover telemetry remain pending. 10.0.58: Shared loginResponse completion queues signin.succeeded through the existing best-effort security event pipeline (#6206, #5659). Actor and tenant come from the resolved login and request metadata from the actual local context. Cookie/JWT preparation failures emit no success event. Existing lastLoginTime/session behavior is preserved; other admin completion paths and account-takeover telemetry remain pending. 10.0.57: Explicit accountToken/token tenant headers take precedence over legacy tenant cookies and numeric account app settings (#6196, #5152). An invalid or unavailable header token cannot fall back to a cookie, config, Origin or hostname; accountToken retains priority over token. Existing account header/query selector priority and the numeric read allowlist remain unchanged. External consumers must verify mixed-header/cookie behavior before adoption; numeric cookie/config retirement and release observation remain pending. 10.0.56: Behavior change for external consumers (net3000-ca/applications#6133 / #5152): numeric account headers now share the AllowAccountIdQueryAttribute GET/HEAD allowlist with ?account=<id>, including RequiredQueryKey restrictions. Unmarked endpoints and writes ignore numeric headers and continue to existing token/host resolution. Pass an account GUID token for writes; GUID account headers remain tokens. New AccountIdQueryPolicy.TryGetAllowedAccountHeader logs positive ids used or ignored. Numeric cookie/config compatibility and the query allowlist remain pending parent retirement. 10.0.55: Platform legal documents (net3000-ca/applications#5662): net3000.common.Legal.LegalDocuments (Current, AcceptsAllCurrent, StageAsync, OutstandingAsync) with tos/aup/privacy at v1 unless LegalDocuments:{code}:version is set. TenantSignupService.BeginAsync takes the accepted versions and writes the three legalDocumentAcceptances rows in the same transaction as the trial account; a signup without current acceptance gets TenantSignupOutcome.LegalNotAccepted. No schema change. 10.0.54: net3000.Configuration.CatalogConnectionStrings moves here from netlibCore (net3000-ca/applications#5302) so a host can run the #2434 catalog verification and the #4812 staging live-catalog check without taking a reference on the legacy monolith; Accounts adopts both. Same namespace and API, so existing callers are unchanged. 10.0.53: Public tenant signup gate (#5657): TenantSignupService, TenantSignupPolicy, TenantSignupEmail, DisposableEmailDomains (vendored CC0 list), SharedRateBudget; tenantSignups, rateBudgets and disposableEmailDomains tables. Requires SQL Updates/2026-10-31-5657-tenant-signup-gate.sql and SQL Updates/2026-11-01-5657-signup-email-claims.sql. Verified mailbox claims survive owner email changes; signup tokens bind the intended mailbox. Demo outbound and search guards also hold self-registered trials. Additive API; signup itself stays off behind AppSettings:tenantSignupEnabled. 10.0.52: emailMessage.ApplyTemplateRow(emailTemplate) applies one already-chosen template row exactly as SetEmailTemplateAsync does after resolving by code, which now delegates to it (net3000-ca/applications#5594). Additive API; existing callers render identically. 10.0.51: Support chat attachments (#5673): chatAttachmentUsage table, accountPlan.ChatAttachmentsAllowed, CdnUploadValidation.Profile.Attachment. 10.0.50: Modern password hashing (#5663): lib.HashPassword stores PBKDF2 Identity V3 (n3pbkdf2$ prefix); hashMe remains legacy SHA-512 for verify/tests; VerifyPassword accepts modern + SHA-512/encrypt/plaintext with transparent re-hash on login; password history hashed; public policy checks HIBP; Password:LegacyCutoffUtc cut-off for encrypt/plaintext (default 2027-01-01). Additive helpers PasswordHashing / TryUpgradePasswordHashAsync / CountLegacyPasswordHashesAsync. 10.0.49: Add IServiceCollection AddNet3000DataProtection overload for legacy Host/Startup applications; adopt persistent restricted key rings in accounts, iframes, views, DemoApplications, errorLoggingAPI and AccountsMCP (#5622). Existing builder API and fail-closed ACL behavior unchanged. 10.0.48: Add AddNet3000DataProtection for persistent, environment-separated platform key rings with Windows machine DPAPI and restricted folder ACLs; startup refuses unwritable or broadly accessible key folders (#5604). Additive API; net3000.core and api adopt it. Nuget.org publication and sibling adoption remain deferred. 10.0.47: Password validation accepts a required special character at any position, including the final character (#5139, #2614). Other staff complexity rules and the public-client length-only policy are unchanged. 10.0.46: DemoOutboundGuard.SocialSuppressedResponse (plain and typed) is the one response a suppressed social post reports, and DemoOutboundError.ReadOnly is the errorCode every suppressed demo outbound response carries (net3000-ca/applications#5545). Additive API only. 10.0.45: Social feed posts join the shared outbound guard (net3000-ca/applications#5497): DemoOutboundChannel.Social, DemoOutboundGuard.MayPostToSocialFeed, lib.MayPostToSocialFeed, and the SocialSuppressedTitle / SocialSuppressedMessage copy every publish path reports. A Facebook or LinkedIn feed post for an account with IsDemoAccount = 1 is suppressed before the provider is called and written to demoWriteAudit as outbound:social; there is no staff allowlist for this channel because a post has no recipient address. Additive API only; non-demo accounts publish exactly as before, and a failed demo-flag lookup allows the post. 10.0.44: net3000.common.Services.ThemeAuthoring.ThemeViewCodes - the theme view codes the Accounts renderer asks for (the alias table plus the codes loaders request verbatim), moved out of the Accounts web app so the netarea theme screens map applicationViews.viewName onto a real code instead of creating views nothing renders (net3000-ca/applications#5496). Additive API only; alias contents and renderer resolution order are unchanged. 10.0.43: BuildInfo (Current, ShortCommit) and IEndpointRouteBuilder.MapBuildInfo(), an anonymous never-cached GET /build-info returning the entry assembly's git commit, version, build time and environment, so a staging verification pass can confirm which build it is testing (net3000-ca/applications#5413). Additive API only. 10.0.42: Task and credit hours are exact decimals (net3000-ca/applications#5392). tsk_tasks.hours, tsk_tasks.billableHours and tsk_credit.hours change from double? to decimal? and map to DECIMAL(9,2); accounts-2 and accounts-2_staging must have run SQL Updates/2026-10-26-5392-task-credit-hours-decimal.sql before a consumer loads this version, or EF materialisation of those rows fails. Breaking for external consumers that read or assign these properties as double (the accounting app, net3000-ca/accounting#184): recompile against this package and go live in the same release window as the SQL, refreshing the zaccounting tsk_* cross-catalog views. The views pass the columns straight through, so an older consumer reading them breaks as soon as the SQL runs. 10.0.41: Behaviour change for external consumers (net3000-ca/applications#5152): lib.account no longer selects a tenant from ?account=<id> on every request. The numeric query id now counts only on GET/HEAD endpoints that carry the new AllowAccountIdQueryAttribute (or a host that adds AllowAccountIdQueryConvention); everywhere else it is ignored and resolution falls through to the account token, cookies, host and Origin. A host that relied on ?account= must mark its read-only endpoints or pass ?accounttoken=. The numeric account header is unchanged. New: AllowAccountIdQueryAttribute, AllowAccountIdQueryConvention and AccountIdQueryPolicy (IsAllowed, TryGetAllowedAccountId, LogIdSelector), which log every id-selected request under the net3000.common.AccountIdSelector category. 10.0.40: Private video hosting on Cloudflare Stream, CM side (net3000-ca/applications#4275): cm_videos gains streamUid / streamStatus / durationSeconds / streamThumbnailUrl plus the derived isPrivateHosted flag, and net3000.cloudflareStream.StreamTenantTag carries the creator and meta.env tags that keep live and staging from deleting each other's Stream videos. Additive API only; videos without a streamUid are unchanged. 10.0.39: Principal identity resolution refuses disabled, deleted, and missing logins before reconstructing identity from existing JWT/cookie claims (#5309). Applies to lightweight and full-data loading; existing APIs preserved. 10.0.38: Job Board employer authorization accepts an entitled membership-backed public jb Team; public login checks application eligibility before issuing a session (#2614). Existing logMeIn signatures preserved. 10.0.37: ScriptLoaderCacheService writes its cache-version stamps with appCode null instead of the nonexistent "core" application, so JS/CSS and asset saves no longer fail on the settings-to-applications foreign key after committing (net3000-ca/applications#1129). No API change. 10.0.36: Public password-reset emails route non-rendering platform hosts to iframes and preserve account-token context (#5286). 10.0.35: PlaceholderInput (ContainsMarker, FirstMarkedField, Refusal, Message) detects buyer text that could become a placeholder token, so entry points can refuse it (net3000-ca/applications#5140). Text outside printable ASCII is re-checked after dropping the characters the merge's InvariantCultureIgnoreCase comparison ignores (soft hyphen, zero-width space, controls) and NFKC normalization. Additive. 10.0.34: One friendly link per page per account (net3000-ca/applications#5133): lib.FindFriendlyLinkConflictAsync, lib.TrySetLinkAsync, FriendlyLinkTargets, FriendlyLinkConflict and FriendlyLinkSaveResult. setLinkAsync / setLink now refuse a slug another page on the account already owns instead of overwriting that page's row, and a blank slug with no pagePath is a no-op. 10.0.33: NoPlaceholderAttribute and exclude overloads of replacePlaceholders keep secret-bearing properties out of a placeholder merge; account.settings is marked (net3000-ca/applications#5130). The existing replacePlaceholders signatures are unchanged and forward to the new overloads, so compiled callers still bind. Two output changes, not additive: a merge over an account row no longer substitutes ##account.settings## / ##settings## (it blanks them), and a null or unparseable DateTime now blanks ##nametime## where it previously left the token standing - visible in subjects and in page-content merges, which removePlaceHolders does not clean. 10.0.32: AdEventRecorder.ViewerHashSecretConfigName and VerifyViewerHashSecret - host-startup check so Production fails fast without AdNetwork:ViewerHashSecret (net3000-ca/applications#4766). Additive. 10.0.31: Per-theme demo branding (ThemeDemoBranding gate, completeness check and layout overlay) so one demo account can show a different company, logo and phone per theme (net3000-ca/applications#3812, #3816). Additive. 10.0.30: Rate-limit rejections write JSON for fetch/XHR and leave browser navigations empty so status-code pages can redirect to /message/429 (net3000-ca/applications#4537). 10.0.29: Shared account-level outbound guard (net3000-ca/applications#4065): DemoOutboundGuard / DemoOutboundChannel, lib.MaySendOutbound / FilterOutboundRecipients, DemoWriteAuditOutcome.Suppressed. Email, SMS, WhatsApp and push sent for an account with IsDemoAccount = 1 are suppressed and audited (except to the staff allowlist, DemoOutbound:StaffAllowlist, default @net3000.ca / @net3000.co); emailMessage and the SMTP sends in lib / scheduledTasks route through it. Non-demo accounts unchanged; a failed demo-flag lookup allows the send and logs. 10.0.28: Demo sandbox and theme preview shared API (net3000-ca/applications#3812): DemoSandboxScope/DemoSandboxState, lib.IsDemoSandboxed / ClassifyRequestForDemoSandbox / RebindDemoSandboxToCurrentAccount, DemoSandboxSaveInterceptor, DemoSandboxSentinelId / NewDemoSandboxReference / MergeDemoSandboxReference, DemoSandboxSignInResponse / DemoSandboxEmailLinkResponse, accountsDB.IsDemoAccount(accountId) extension, and email/push/payment seams that skip sends on a sandboxed demo request. Additive API only; non-demo requests unchanged. 10.0.27: Add net3000.AdNetwork off-request event pipeline (AdEventQueue, AdEventRecorder, AdEventFlushService, AddAdNetworkEvents) and the content-2 AdEvents entity + contentDB.AdEvents DbSet (net3000-ca/applications#3387). Additive API only. 10.0.26: Add net3000.common.Services.ThemeAuthoring - ThemeAuthoringService (theme save, deep duplicate, HTML-to-blocks view import/re-import, block save, declarative view composition) and ThemePageCodes, moved out of net3000.core ThemesController so the AccountsMCP theme tools share the admin rules (net3000-ca/applications#3085). Additive API only. 10.0.25: Add lib.ResolveSocialImage / lib.GetSocialImagePool - shared og:image resolution (metaTagFeatureImage -> featureImage -> account socialImagePool setting) for every app's meta-tag builder. Pool is opt-in by absence: accounts with no socialImagePool row resolve to null and emit no og:image, as before. Additive API only. 10.0.24: Depend on Portable.BouncyCastle 1.9.0 instead of BouncyCastle.NetCore 2.2.1. Both shipped a file named BouncyCastle.Crypto.dll with incompatible identities (1.9.0.0 signed vs 0.0.0.0 unsigned); last-writer-wins resolution broke WebPush's strong-named bind on deployed hosts. No API change - the crypto code compiles unchanged and ciphertext is byte-for-byte identical. Also drops dangling BouncyCastle.Crypto and HtmlAgilityPack assembly-reference HintPaths pointing into gitignored bin folders. 10.0.23: Add IListUnsubscribeLookup contract so app audience providers can subtract per-list unsubscribes without referencing mailingListDB. 10.0.22: Bootstrap 5 dual-compatibility in emitted admin nav markup - the two nav-dropdown emitters now emit data-bs-toggle alongside data-toggle so the markup drives dropdowns under both Bootstrap 4 and 5 (epic net3000-ca/applications#1764, issue #1795). No API changes. 10.0.21: Restore assembly name to 'common' (10.0.20 shipped as net3000.common.dll, breaking Net3000.Content's contentDB reference).
